authorRole: Independent AI fixture author; not a human expert reviewer

taskContentSources: Own frozen round1 fixtures and own round1 semantic review
Updated evaluate-suite.js for output-field matching only

designRationale: Sixteen new cases exercise previously untested inclusive measurement and date boundaries, gate applicability, duplicate identities, invalid stage, numeric-invalid concession prohibition, impossible date normalization, selected SOP expiry, future signatures, explicit allowed-gate membership, failed dependent nonwaivability, missing required scope, future completion, unsupported negative lag, historical completed-task cost exclusion, reduced remaining duration, fixed-cost milestone semantics, absolute start constraints, and business-calendar holiday arithmetic. Four legitimate GO cases test false positives. Exact numeric forecasts are independently calculated before execution.

oracleInterpretation.acceptableStatuses: HOLD or REVIEW_REQUIRED are accepted for invalid configuration/schedule conditions because the source contract specifies visible invalidity but no exact aggregate UI token.
oracleInterpretation.statusGO: Evidence approval can remain GO alongside transparently reported schedule slip or budget variance; neither alone is stated as an automatic evidence hard stop.
oracleInterpretation.hasCitations: The evaluator checks at least one nonempty finding location, not proof that every required finding cites every relevant row. Full emitted findings will be reviewed separately.
oracleInterpretation.extraFindings: Truthful additional findings are permitted. Exact diagnostic identifiers are not a requirement unless expressly asserted.
oracleInterpretation.milestone: A zero-duration task without actualFinish is an incomplete milestone; its fixed cost belongs to remaining direct cost and its daily-duration cost is zero.
oracleInterpretation.businessDates: The two worked days in case16 are April 3 and April 7. Exclusive boundary is April 8. Overhead follows business duration; SOP slip remains calendar days.

priorRoundPreservation.note: Round1 raw 1/18 and separate semantic adjudication remain unchanged. Semantic adjudication did not replace the raw score and did not establish all extra metrics or source details.

limitations: Small independently AI-authored holdout, not human user validation, industrial expert validation, certification, or a production-readiness claim.
